Rong ston pa (ID:6005)’s main lineage of Abhisamayālaṃkāra (ID:3706) according to [VTFXMPC9]: xxi-xxii is: Thub pa chen po (ID:7966), Byams pa (ID:3747), Thogs med (ID:3756), dByig gnyen (ID:3758), 'Phags pa Grol sde (ID:3708), bTsun pa Grol sde (ID:5548), mChog gi sde (ID:8107), Dul ba'i sde (ID:7905), rNam snang bzang po (ID:8010), Seng ge bzang po (ID:3712), Sangs rgyas ye shes (ID:5830), Guṇamitra (ID: 8218), Ratnabhadra (Rin chen bzang po (ID:3784)), Shar phyogs pa Zla bzang (ID:8185), 'Bum phrag gsum pa (ID:5611), rNgog lo tsa ba Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786), 'Bre Shes rab 'bar (ID:3807), Ar Byang chub ye shes (ID:3816), 'Dul 'dzin dKar mo gZhon nu tshul khrims (ID:3820), dKar chung ring mo Shes rab 'bum (ID:3821), Zhang g.ye pa Byang chub 'bum (ID:7146), 'Jam pa'i rdo rje (ID:3887), gZad rings Dar ma tshul khrims (ID:4011), brTson 'grus rdo rje (ID:4296), Rin po che [Khro phu ba?] (ID:7014), Lho pa Grub pa'i seng ge (ID:7651), Tshad ma'i skyes bu bSod nams mgon (ID:6925), Bu ston Rin chen grub (ID:5999), sGra tshad pa Rin chen rnam rgyal (ID:7772), g.Yag ston Sangs rgyas dpal (ID:6153), Rong ston (ID:6005). 

[VTFXMPC9]: xxi-xxii notes that Bu ston (ID:5999) records an "Old Phar phyin lineage" (phar phyin rnying ma) the 'Brom lugs, which is an alternative lineage between Haribhadra (ID:3712) and 'Bre Shes rab 'bar (ID:3807): Seng ge bzang po (ID:3712), Ku sa li che ba (ID: 7789), Ku sa li chung ba (ID:7790), gSer gling pa Chos kyi grags pa (ID:6840), Jo bo Atiśa (ID:3745), 'Brom ston rGyal ba'i 'byung gnas (ID:3827), ‘Brom sTong btsan Nam mgo bla ma (ID:8402), ‘Bre chen po Shes rab ‘bar (ID:3807).
